quiet:
The tide came in slowly over the rocks
and then went out again.
She walked to the shop
and bought a loaf.
They sang together
all night long.
The tide went out over the sand
and left many shells.
He rode to the town
and sold a horse.
They danced together
all night long.
The rain came down over the hill
and filled the lake.
We drove to the coast
and ate some fish.
